_comment: run_30 mesh on/off scan schedule (2026-07-11). Six scans keyed by the leading sub-run-name token. MULTI-BOARD schema: each target may carry its own 'board' (default = top-level board). The watcher toggles INPUT-CHANNEL status (not function lemo enables) to select triggers, drives the M4.D-in0 (PS line) Gate&Delay for the scint scans, and switches the mesh injection by enabling/disabling M6.B's four outputs. Pre-run one-time setup (function types + enables + injection delay 1260): n1081b/setup_run30_trigger.py. Restore mode 'snapshot' returns every touched channel to its found state on exit. Previous (self-trig) schedule: n1081b_scan_schedule.json.selftrig_backup.

_trigger_map.d_in0: .243 M4.D ch0 = PS/gamma-flash trigger line (delayed +1980 ns ONLY in scint scans so the flash lands in the 32x60ns window at latency 35; flash peak ~smp 15 there)
_trigger_map.d_in1: .243 M4.D ch1 = M4.C out (scint singles / gated pulser path)
_trigger_map.c_in1: .243 M4.C ch1 = Doubles (M4.B) — disabled in ALL run_30 scans
_trigger_map.c_in4: .243 M4.C ch4 = M6.D random pulser (Poisson 667 Hz, gated by the 30 ms veto)
_trigger_map.mesh_b: .245 M6.B outputs 0-3 = mesh charge-injection (delay knob in0 G&D = 1260 ns, set pre-run)

flashOn._note: PS trigger only (C path cut at D.in1); mesh injection ON; 400x20ns lat 60

flashOff._note: same, mesh injection OFF (M6.B outputs disabled)

randOn._note: PS + veto-gated pulser; singles/doubles cut at C inputs; mesh ON; 32x60ns lat 5

fulltimeOn._note: run_35 full-temporal-space scan (2026-07-13): PS + UNGATED ~67 Hz Poisson pulser, mesh injection ON. Structurally a mirror of randOn, but the 30 ms VETO IS OFF and the pulser is throttled to 15 ms. NOTE the veto-open is NOT expressed here (the schedule only toggles input channels): it comes from M4.C being a plain FN_OR with only lemo4 enabled, plus the 15 ms pulser period — both applied ONCE by n1081b/setup_fulltime_trigger.py before the run. Singles/Doubles are cut both at the C inputs (here) AND at the C function level (there). 32x60ns lat 5.

scintOn._note: PS (delayed +1980ns -> flash peak ~smp 15 at lat 35) + Singles; pulser cut; mesh ON; 32x60ns lat 35

scintOff._note: same, mesh OFF. Watcher snapshot-restore resets d_in0 G&D on exit.

m05On._note: plastic 0.5 MIP (A-66/B-77/C-87/D-74 mV) + mesh ON; scint+ps routing static (pre-run)

m05Off._note: plastic 0.5 MIP (A-66/B-77/C-87/D-74 mV) + mesh OFF; scint+ps routing static (pre-run)

m10Off._note: plastic 1.0 MIP (A-131/B-154/C-174/D-149 mV) + mesh OFF; scint+ps routing static (pre-run)

m15On._note: plastic 1.5 MIP (A-196/B-232/C-261/D-224 mV) + mesh ON; scint+ps routing static (pre-run)

m15Off._note: plastic 1.5 MIP (A-196/B-232/C-261/D-224 mV) + mesh OFF; scint+ps routing static (pre-run)

m20Off._note: plastic 2.0 MIP (A-262/B-309/C-348/D-298 mV) + mesh OFF; scint+ps routing static (pre-run)

m141On._note: run_67: plastic 1.41 MIP (A-185/B-217/C-245/D-210 mV) — NO mesh target: the M6.B mesh circuit was taken FULLY OFF (all inputs and outputs) on 2026-07-22 via set_m6_secB_full_off.py, so scan_control must NOT re-enable it. scint+ps routing static (pre-run).

m141Off._note: run_67: plastic 1.41 MIP (A-185/B-217/C-245/D-210 mV) + mesh OFF; scint+ps routing static (pre-run). GEANT-optimised ladder, optimum (1.41 MIP) and DOWN only — see MX17_Full_Geant .claude/al_pair_background/PLASTIC_THRESHOLD.md and run_config_hv_mesh_thresh_scan.py.

m113Off._note: run_67: plastic 1.13 MIP (A-148/B-174/C-196/D-168 mV) + mesh OFF; scint+ps routing static (pre-run). GEANT-optimised ladder, optimum (1.41 MIP) and DOWN only — see MX17_Full_Geant .claude/al_pair_background/PLASTIC_THRESHOLD.md and run_config_hv_mesh_thresh_scan.py.

mtestOn._note: MESH TOGGLE DIAGNOSTIC (2026-07-22): plastic held at 1.41 MIP (A-185/B-217/C-245/D-210) so the ONLY variable is M6.B outputs ENABLED. Paired with run_config_mesh_toggle_test.py to correlate the DREAM rate and the n_TOF stream wall-flash amplitude against mesh state. Toggles OUTPUTS only (same knob as the historical mesh_b, which produced the 28x effect).

mtestOff._note: MESH TOGGLE DIAGNOSTIC (2026-07-22): plastic held at 1.41 MIP (A-185/B-217/C-245/D-210) so the ONLY variable is M6.B outputs DISABLED. Paired with run_config_mesh_toggle_test.py to correlate the DREAM rate and the n_TOF stream wall-flash amplitude against mesh state. Toggles OUTPUTS only (same knob as the historical mesh_b, which produced the 28x effect).

m200On._note: run_70 plastic-threshold PLATEAU scan (2026-07-23): plastic 2.00 MIP (A-262/B-309/C-348/D-298 mV). NO mesh target on purpose — after the 2026-07-23 M6 re-cable the mesh sits on SEC_B out2/out3 and SEC_B/C enables are aliased, so scan_control must not touch M6 in this run. scint+ps routing static (pre-run).

m070On._note: run_70 plastic-threshold PLATEAU scan (2026-07-23): plastic 0.70 MIP (A-92/B-108/C-122/D-104 mV). NO mesh target on purpose — after the 2026-07-23 M6 re-cable the mesh sits on SEC_B out2/out3 and SEC_B/C enables are aliased, so scan_control must not touch M6 in this run. scint+ps routing static (pre-run).

acmeshOn._note: run_71 mesh ON: enable SEC_B out2 (det A) + out3 (det C) charge-injection legs ONLY. out0/out1 (SiPM-enable bias) untouched -- this is the fix for the SEC_C-out cross-talk that collapsed the SiPM walls 28x in run_67. Paired with run_config_mesh_onoff_hv_scan.py; drift/resist HV driven by the DREAM scan. Plastic HELD at 1.41 MIP (A-185/B-217/C-245/D-210).

acmeshOff._note: run_71 mesh OFF: disable SEC_B out2/out3 (det A/C mesh legs) only; SiPM enables out0/out1 stay ON. If the walls still collapse on OFF, the mesh<->wall coupling is NOT the SEC_C-out alias -- this run is the test. Plastic HELD at 1.41 MIP (A-185/B-217/C-245/D-210).

cosbounce._note: run_72 BEAM-OFF cosmics resist bounce (run_config_cosmics_hv_bounce.py). Sets the M2 plastic discriminators to 0.5 MIP (A-65/B-78/C-86/D-83, calibrations/pss/mip_thresholds_y88.json) and NOTHING ELSE -- cosmics are MIPs (Landau MPV = 1 MIP), so run_71's standing 1.41 MIP bar would cut most of them; 0.5 MIP is ~3x the trigger rate. NO mesh target: the mesh ON/OFF axis was dropped because M6.B in0 (the injection trigger) is PS/T0-fed and never fires with beam off, so board .245 is not touched by this run at all. Walls (M1) not touched. Resist/drift HV driven by the DREAM scan, not by this tag.

stat090._note: run_77 STATISTICS run at the single run_67 operating point (calibrations/mm/statistics_run_config_run67.json). Plastic discriminators at 0.90 MIP (A-118/B-139/C-157/D-134 mV) -- same numbers as m090On/m090Off, i.e. the run_67 threshold ladder rung the calibration selects on tracks-per-spill. Mesh charge-injection held OFF: disable SEC_B out2/out3 (det A/C legs) only, exactly as acmeshOff does; SiPM-enable bias out0/out1 is NOT touched. Every sub-run carries this same tag, so scan_control re-asserts thresholds + mesh-off each sub-run -- there is no scan axis in run_77, this is a HOLD. HV is driven by the DREAM config, not by this tag.

thr090._note: run_83 PLASTIC-THRESHOLD ladder for the 1-10 ms acceptance-comb spikiness study (2026-07-27). Identical in shape to `stat090` — mesh charge-injection held OFF (SEC_B out2/out3 only; SiPM-enable bias out0/out1 NOT touched) — and differing ONLY in the M2 plastic discriminator level, so threshold is the single variable against the run_79/run_81 production point. 0.90 MIP = A-118/B-139/C-157/D-134 mV. mV values are byte-identical to `m090On` (run_67/run_70) so this ladder is directly comparable to that data. Rationale: run_79 shows the comb only where the offered rate is high (33% of 1-10 ms starved at 3.1-5.6 kHz; 20-40 ms comb-FREE at 1.27 kHz), so cutting the singles rate should clear it the way time already does. thr090 IS the production point and is the in-run control. ⚠ scan_control does NOT restore section thresholds on exit — re-apply 0.90 MIP by hand afterwards.
